name: The Toby Project (Brooklyn feral coordinator)
neighborhoods: All 5 boroughs (free community-cat spay/neuter); Brooklyn TNR coordinator
notes: Free spay/neuter for community cats in all five boroughs, for Certified TNR Caretakers. Manhattan, Brooklyn and Staten Island: ring (347) 816-2899, Tuesday to Saturday 1-7pm, for its Brooklyn clinic (Sundays and Mondays, by appointment). Bronx and Queens: email TobyProjectNYC@gmail.com for its weekly mobile clinic. Its website is slow to open.

Free spay/neuter + eartip for community cats in all five boroughs (surgery free; donations requested). Contact the Brooklyn coordinator for BK colony projects. Verify current schedule. Intake: Call or email to schedule mobile spay/neuter

FREE community-cat spay/neuter, all 5 boroughs (Certified TNR Caretakers). Brooklyn, Manhattan and Staten Island: (347) 816-2899. Bronx/Queens mobile: Tobyprojectnyc@gmail.com.

NYC's only org solely devoted to free/low-cost spay/neuter; mobile vans + in-neighborhood clinics, works with DOHMH. Free spay/neuter with proof of public assistance, reduced without. Email tobyprojectnyc@gmail.com (Bronx & Queens mobile scheduling) or (212) 315-5251; https://www.tobyproject.org/services.
